overview: Pistons that push up to three blocks instead of one. Right-click a powered piston with an empty hand to cycle how far it reaches.

1.0.1: The tip card says how far this one pushes, which you cannot see from the outside.
It stays quiet at a reach of one.
A mason's lesson asks for a reach of three, so somebody finds out the trick is there at all.
1.0.0: A regular or sticky piston extends one, two or three blocks, cycled by hand.
A Piston Shaft fills the gap between base and head, and sticky pistons still pull back.
A push that would fail on a vanilla piston still fails here.
